item.title: Show HN: AI agents can now safely write to your CRMs
item.summary: Hi HN! Just wanted to share that I've built Archron - Execution governance for AI in business. It allows agents to safely write to CRMs(starting from Salesforce and hubspot) while maintaining immutable audit logs. Demo: https://youtu.be/uUTWGwJjpdA Would love to hear your thoughts about this and feedback. We are offering 3 months free to test it in your business workflow.
